title: Rate limiting
description: Clients send requests to an API with a slow, fragile backend behind it. Add Ruvio's rate limiter and watch who gets through.

reset.label: Reset limits
reset.hint: Flushes the demo database in Ruvio and clears the API's counters, so the next take starts from a full budget.

endpoints.label: naive, no limit
endpoints.expect: Nothing limits the callers. With many clients the backend slows down, then starts answering 503.

endpoints.label: fixed window
endpoints.expect: Each client may send 10 requests per 10 seconds. The rest get 429 with Retry-After, and the budget is shared by every API instance.

endpoints.label: sliding window (preview)
endpoints.expect: Same budget, but the previous window still counts, so there is no double burst at the window edge. Retry-After is exact.

endpoints.label: token bucket (preview)
endpoints.expect: A bucket of 10 tokens that refills over 10 seconds: smooth traffic. Retry-After is exact.

endpoints.label: global default
endpoints.expect: No policy of its own, so the whole-API policy demo-global applies: 30 requests per 10 seconds per client, shared with /api/time and every other endpoint without its own policy.

endpoints.label: attribute, [RuvioRateLimit]
endpoints.expect: The same fixed-window rule written as an attribute on the handler: 10 requests per 10 seconds per client.

endpoints.label: shared policy: shop
endpoints.expect: /api/shop/products and /api/shop/cart share the policy demo-shop, so they spend one budget of 10. Hit /api/shop/products with curl in between and the 429s arrive earlier.

endpoints.label: own policy: checkout
endpoints.expect: A stricter policy of its own (demo-checkout): only 3 requests per 10 seconds, whatever happens on the other shop endpoints.

endpoints.label: Microsoft limiter, in-process
endpoints.expect: The same rule counted in each API instance's own memory, so two instances double the budget. Needs the commented code in Program.cs.

bursts.label: window-edge burst
bursts.note: One request opens the window, a burst lands just before it ends, and a second burst just after. A fixed window lets both through.

presets.name: 1 · No limit
presets.hint: Eight busy clients, a slow backend, nobody limiting them. Watch the 503s and the latency.

presets.name: 2 · Fixed window
presets.hint: Three clients, 10 requests per 10 s each. Everything above that is a 429.

presets.name: 3 · Two instances
presets.hint: The same client talks to two API instances. The budget is still 10, because the counter lives in Ruvio.

presets.name: 4 · Window edge
presets.hint: A burst before and after the window edge. Run it on fixed, then on sliding or token bucket.

presets.name: 5 · Ruvio goes down
presets.hint: Steady traffic. Stop the Ruvio container while it runs and see what the Outage mode does.
